# Godot MCP Server

> The npm-distributed MCP bridge (`@npgamedev/godot-mcp-server`, TypeScript)
> that connects an MCP client — Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, and
> others — to a Godot 4.2+ editor. It pairs with the `godot-mcp-toolkit`
> editor plugin, which hosts localhost WebSocket servers inside the editor and
> the running game; this server speaks MCP over stdio to the client and
> translates tool calls onto those channels.

This repository is the npm package root. The editor plugin lives in its own
repository and ships via the Godot Asset Library.

## Docs

- [Documentation map](docs/README.md): every docs surface, organized by what
  you want to do (use, extend, contribute).
- [Tool reference](docs/tool-reference/README.md): generated reference of
  every tool and operation — the canonical list.
- [MCP client setup](docs/mcp-clients.md): per-client configuration (Claude
  Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, and more) with per-OS paths and
  gotchas.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture/README.md): subsystems, transport, the
  contract surface shared with the toolkit, key decisions, with diagrams.
- [Token efficiency](docs/token-efficiency.md): measured context-window cost
  of the tool surface.
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability, the security
  model, and isolation guidance.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): environment setup, checks, commit format,
  and the documentation rules.

## Companion plugin (godot-mcp-toolkit)

- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/NPGameDev/godot-mcp-toolkit/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md):
  the 60-second checklist, connectivity probe, and symptom-to-fix entries —
  one canonical page for both repositories.
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/NPGameDev/godot-mcp-toolkit/blob/main/addons/godot_mcp_toolkit/docs/compatibility.md):
  supported Godot versions, per-version tool behavior, headless mode, C#
  requirements, export stripping.
